title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text input sharing Input's sizes and variants; manual resizing is disabled, set rows instead.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled textarea; native attributes pass through.

sizes-variants.title: Sizes and variants
sizes-variants.description: Sizes change the font size and minimum height.

form-control.title: With FormField
form-control.description: Label, help text, error and required state come from the field.

TextareaProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl); sets aria-invalid

cssVars.--textarea-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the text (defaults to the density's small control padding)
cssVars.--textarea-background: Background color of the outline variant
